label: Formulated the canonical Ontological Argument in Proslogion
description: Anselm of Canterbury formulated and introduced the concept of "The Ontological Argument", which became a seminal contribution in metaphysics philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in metaphysics.
historicalContext: Introduced during the Medieval & Islamic Golden Age as part of Anselm of Canterbury's canonical writings.

label: Pioneered scholastic dialectical theology
description: Thomas Aquinas was fundamentally influenced by Anselm of Canterbury's central inquiries, which shaped the evolution of their philosophical worldview.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Anselm of Canterbury's perspective to Thomas Aquinas's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Direct contemporaneous dialogue and pedagogical transmission during the Medieval & Islamic Golden Age era.
